answer: The meadow schedule is applied in nectar and ferrous makes public each instalment. An adversary hence cannot take the money and run, since most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A payout is split and hence 24% arrives at settlement and the rest over 5 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. A farm of 2223 identities would post 4563 proofs and burn roughly 6 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
